notes.title: DLC-Kanji Plan coming
notes.content:
Hello,dear players
The DLC-Kanji Plan is coming~~~~~~


[b]brief introduction:[/b]
1. In this DLC, you can perform convenient Kanji query (enter Hiragana, or paste the word directly into the search box). You can see the detailed meaning ofKanji in WIki.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32751807/d12a65e178adcaf3722b267ac45abf9cbd63220a.jpg[/img]

2.Daily Plan:Learn 10 Kanji every day. Over time, I believe you can read most Japanese articles.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32751807/8bc536cc44cb3dfc4eed3fb5b1d66b29c40f5f8b.jpg[/img]

3.Common websites: WIki, Google Translate, youtube.etc.

4. I use HTML for development so that you can run on different platforms; and you can modify the code yourself.


*Price：0.99$
You can choose to buy to give me support~~( *￣▽￣)((≧︶≦*)~~
You can also view it on my website for free (the website is being produced)

notes.title: Notice about game remastering
notes.content:
The original intention of my game was to make it easier for Japanese learners to remember Japanese Katakana and Hiragana.ːsteamfacepalmː
(Remembering Japanese kana is a painful thing)


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32751807/bf380a110916e6168c0120e7411ec1b63f919fdd.jpg[/img]

Since the author's work is as busy as a dog, it has not been updated for a long time.
Although I really want to give up, I still choose to bring the best gaming experience and learning path to the supported players.


Since this is my first game, there are a lot of deficiencies. Therefore, I have been thinking about my friends and players for a long time and decided to reset the game in many ways.
Reset release time before January 30, 2019


[h1][b]Changes that will occur after reset: [/b][/h1]
1. Add 50 pseudonym achievements to set up a small goal for you~~~
2. Voice: Add the pronunciation of each pseudonym
3. Voices of commonly used Japanese conversations
4. A free DLC: some learning materials


It is recommended that you copy the current game files before January 7.
To prevent the current archive from disappearing after the update


At last:
There may be a lot of deficiencies, but I will definitely improve.
I also hope that you will learn to be happy and smooth.

Thank you

notes.title: About 2.0 version update instructions
About Some Players' suggestions
notes.content:
First of all, thank you for experiencing this game

      The following questions I will rewrite the script in a timely manner and strive to release the latest version within this week:
           1. Cannot repeatedly kill monsters
           2. Map transfer adjustment
           3. Adjust the amount of falling money


About audio teaching:
    The initial design was to defeat the mobs, purchase the keys, and enter the house with stickers on the door.
    The NPC in the house can perform audio teaching~~~~~
After I have considered some players' suggestions, the new NPC will be added directly to the village for phonetic instruction.


If you have any suggestions or ideas, you can send an email to me, I will seriously consider and study.


Finally, thanks.
